# Kildare Clinic

> GP walk-in medical centre on Claregate Street in Kildare, Ireland.

Source: https://www.kildaredoc.ie/

## Contact and location

- Address: Claregate Street, Kildare, R51 P635, Ireland.
- Telephone: [085 867 8192](tel:+353858678192).
- Email: [info@kildaredoc.ie](mailto:info@kildaredoc.ie).
- WhatsApp: [Contact the clinic](https://wa.me/353858678192).
- Website: https://www.kildaredoc.ie/.

## Services listed on the website

### General Practice

Everyday GP consultations for illness, injury and ongoing health concerns, with no appointment required.

### Family Healthcare

Care for every stage of life, from children's check-ups to health reviews for parents and grandparents.

### Travel Advice

Health guidance before you travel abroad, including advice on recommended vaccines, malaria prevention and precautions for your destination.

### Disease Management

Ongoing monitoring and support for diabetes, blood pressure, asthma and other long-term conditions, with regular reviews to keep your health on track.

## Plan a visit

Walk in or call ahead. Register at the front desk, see the doctor and discuss the next steps for your care. Monday–Thursday: 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM & 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM. Friday–Sunday: closed for now. Contact the clinic to confirm current opening hours, waiting times and service availability before travelling.

## Location question

The clinic is on Claregate Street, Kildare, R51 P635 — look for the black and gold signage.

# About Kildare Clinic

Source: https://www.kildaredoc.ie/about

Kildare Clinic is a local GP walk-in practice on Claregate Street, Kildare. The website describes general practice, family healthcare, travel advice and ongoing support for long-term conditions.

## Location and contact

- Address: Claregate Street, Kildare, R51 P635, Ireland.
- Telephone: [085 867 8192](tel:+353858678192).
- Email: [info@kildaredoc.ie](mailto:info@kildaredoc.ie).
- WhatsApp: [Contact the clinic](https://wa.me/353858678192).
- Website: https://www.kildaredoc.ie/.

## Visiting the practice

The practice welcomes walk-in visits and also describes booked appointments for visits that benefit from planning ahead. Monday–Thursday: 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM & 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM. Friday–Sunday: closed for now. Contact the clinic to confirm current opening hours, waiting times and service availability before travelling.

## Opening hours and availability

Monday–Thursday: 10:00 AM – 2:00 PM & 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM. Friday–Sunday: closed for now. Contact the clinic to confirm current opening hours, waiting times and service availability before travelling.

## Contact methods

Call, email or WhatsApp the clinic directly. Email is listed for non-urgent queries. The contact page includes a location map.

# Kildare Clinic health notes

Source: https://www.kildaredoc.ie/blog

The blog page currently contains article titles and short previews. Full articles and individual article URLs are not available. These previews should not be presented as complete, medically reviewed guidance.

## Preview topics

- Do you need the flu vaccine this year? (Seasonal Health).
- Planning a trip abroad? Book your travel consultation early (Travel Health).
- Living with high blood pressure: a practical guide (Long-Term Conditions).
- Why we kept walk-in consultations when other clinics didn't (Clinic News).
- A parent's checklist for childhood immunisations (Family Health).
- When to see a GP versus when to wait it out (Everyday Health).
